manifest.name: doc-drift
manifest.description: Scans a codebase against its documentation and reports drift.

readme_md:
# Doc Drift Detector

Compares what your docs claim against what your code actually does.

## Usage

```
primordial run github:octo-tools/doc-drift --workspace ./my-project
```

It flags:

- Out-of-date command examples
- Renamed or removed CLI flags
- Features in code with no documentation
- Docs referencing files that no longer exist

## Workspace access

This agent needs **readwrite** access to your git workspace so it can leave annotations. It only touches a git worktree copy — see the Workspace Isolation docs.
